backing.tranche_position_basis: Re equity absorbs first loss; reUSDe mezzanine absorbs second; reUSD senior absorbs last. Source: PegTracker reusde_re_backing.json loss_waterfall, 2026-09-03.
backing.eligible_sleeve_note: Eligible sleeve assets are a mandate, not holdings. DefiLlama program TVL includes off-chain-assets oracle value in its USDC category; it is not tranche-attributed cash allocation.
backing.backing_score_basis: Authored 5.5 held: credible shared reinsurance book, but current contractual first-loss thickness and tranche reserve attribution are unestablished. Mezzanine impairment and exit constraints are addressed on their corresponding axes.
backing.backing_score_applies_when_note: ⚠️ MUST NOT fire on a merely-absent collateral_ratio. The producer DECLARES this one underivable in collateral_ratio_basis. A bare null can also mean a failed fetch or a feed outage — promoting an authored score over a measurement that exists but did not load is the failure where a failed read lands wherever the substitute sits. Require the DECLARATION, not the absence.
backing.no_attachment_point_note: No current contractual first-loss numerator is established. Historical $20M scenario capital and senior attachment ratios must not be substituted for reUSDe's current cushion.
